scope: carbon price prediction, not association or causal economic inference; direct predictor, not a Stage D/E filter wrapper
candidate: causal multiscale signed-interaction network (working label only)

features.local_scale: RMS of the same 60 past price increments; zero scale maps to zero input and zero correction
features.x: orthonormal block-sum contrasts of increments divided by local scale; dates for chronology only

architecture.basis: F(x)=[x, (u_k dot x)*tanh((v_k dot x)*(w_k dot x)) for k=1..4]
architecture.projection_constraint: each of u,v,w has Euclidean norm at most 1
architecture.prediction: p_t + s_t * F(x_t) dot B_h, h=1,5,20
architecture.symmetry: exact sign-reflection equivariance of corrections; positive affine equivariance of price mapping; these are inductive assumptions, not market laws
architecture.learning: for each backbone iterate solve the ridge output head exactly on mature labels, differentiate profiled training objective, Adam learning rate .02 for 160 steps; retain best training objective including initialization, not a validation checkpoint
architecture.target_loss: mean over horizons of price squared error divided by fixed initial-training horizon scale squared, plus ridge head and backbone penalties

comparators.LINEAR8: same block inputs, ordinary ridge output
comparators.LINEAR60: full raw increment lag window, training-only scale
comparators.MLP: 9 tanh hidden units with biases and linear skip; profiled ridge head; 135 parameters
comparators.ODD_MLP: 10 bias-free tanh hidden units with linear skip; profiled ridge head; 134 parameters
comparators.FROZEN_INTERACTION: same interaction basis frozen at initialization; same ridge head
comparators.KRR: RBF and its odd symmetrization, bandwidths .5,2,8 and ridge .01,.1,1; maximum 9 configurations per family; ordinary RBF has an intercept, odd kernel does not
comparators.TREE: HistGradientBoosting leaves7/15, learning_rate .05/.1, l2 .1/1, 80 iterations, no random early stopping
comparators.CORE_ML: Stage D's existing 31-model price-filter bank, past likelihood windows120/240/480; known-method baseline only

synthetic.refitting: fit at 800 for tuning and at 1200 for evaluation, no other synthetic refits; output scales always from first 800 observations
synthetic.oracle: known conditional one-step mean only for nonlinear processes; not presented as a multi-step oracle
synthetic.selection: choose output ridge by mean tuning loss over model seeds, separately on each generated trajectory; refit chosen setting on same three seeds and report mean loss, never ensemble
synthetic.minimum_gate: candidate null mean relative MSE <=1.05; candidate linear mean relative MSE <.99; candidate interaction one-step MSE at least 5% below RW and below LINEAR8; all outputs finite; asymmetric case reported but not a pass requirement
synthetic.mechanism_scope: these are minimal signal-learning controls, not a claim of synthetic superiority over every comparator; formal architecture-advantage checks remain mandatory on development data

market_plan.development_selection: 2020-2021; use origins whose 1/5/20 targets remain in same year
market_plan.training_window: last 480 common mature origins, expanding until available; all fitted direct predictors share this support
market_plan.no_new_dates: 2022,2023,2024 never scored; Hubei/EU audited only, not trained
market_plan.primary_metric: equal-year equal-horizon MSE ratios to RW
market_plan.same_information: 60 past price increments, current price and causal local scale; lowdim baseline gets the same available price history but is explicitly a different state summarizer
market_plan.Cstar: best development-selected noncandidate in complete declared pool; no test-stage reselection
market_plan.continuation_gate: candidate primary score >=2% better than RW and Cstar, >=1% better than both ODD_MLP and FROZEN_INTERACTION, no development year >5% worse than RW; otherwise stop
market_plan.uncertainty: paired within-year moving blocks20/40/60,2000 repetitions; all horizons and models jointly sampled; selected-development intervals not confirmation

tests: zero interaction head reduces to LINEAR8
frozen features equal finite-feature kernel ridge
same architecture versus comparator parameter counts
no future periods in market input
no latent generator states supplied to learners
literature_limits: Odd kernels in price prediction (2012), multiplicative/polynomial networks and scale-aware forecasting already exist. The particular constrained learned interaction encoder is only a hypothesis, not certified first use. Do not retry prior blocked PDFs. Record new sources by metadata, abstract, method-section reading or full audit separately.
budget_rules: Keep all configurations, train failures and first-run outputs. Do not alter processes, splits, seeds or cutoffs after scores to rescue the candidate. Distinct new model code only; do not retry the previously blocked Stage E source payload.
delivery: versioned protocol, source, checks, complete results and literature ledger on separate branch where permitted; no main merge, no successful results paper before mechanism and predictive confirmation
